description: Several attempts at the SAME piece of work, side by side: one column per attempt with its state, its score, its own summary, the body the host renders and the votes it collected — and a winner the reader picks and confirms. The surface renders the attempts it is given and never mutates them and never invents a score: the best attempt is the host's explicit pick (BestAttemptId) when it names one, otherwise ParallelAttemptRanking resolves the highest score, so the column badge, the comparison table and a test can never disagree. Picking a winner is deliberately TWO steps. The native radios of one shared name are the choice — the arrow keys walk them natively, with no key emulation — and a pick asks for confirmation before OnSelect fires, so a stray arrow key can never replace a recorded result. The confirmation lives in a named group, the pick is announced once through the surface's ONE polite live region, and the focus returns to the radio that opened the question. The columns are a horizontal scroll-snap track: a narrow container turns them into a carousel with no JavaScript and no second layout engine. The comparison table below repeats every number as text, which is the surface a screen reader or a phone reads.

parameters.name: Attempts
parameters.description: The attempts to compare, in the host's own order. Each one is a column and a row of the comparison table; the surface never reorders them, so the host's order stays the reader's order. Null or empty renders the localized empty state.

parameters.name: BestAttemptId
parameters.description: The host's explicit pick of the best attempt. When it names one of Attempts that attempt wears the "Best" mark whatever its score; when it names nothing (or something absent) the highest score decides. Null by default.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the root element.

parameters.name: ConfirmSelection
parameters.description: Whether a pick asks for confirmation before it becomes the winner. Default true — the safe default, so a stray arrow key inside the radio group cannot replace a recorded result. A host that wants a one-step choice passes false and the pick raises OnSelect immediately.

parameters.name: ContentTemplate
parameters.description: The host's own body for one attempt — a diff, a document, a code block, plain prose. Rendered inside that attempt's column, so every body stays bound to its own attempt. Null renders no body.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: The culture that formats the scores. Null (the default) means the current culture at render time. It never rescales a score: the host's scale is the host's.

parameters.name: HeadingLevel
parameters.description: The heading level of the rendered title, clamped to 2–6. Default 3.

parameters.name: OnSelect
parameters.description: Raised with the attempt id once the reader CONFIRMED it as the result. A host that only needs the value can bind SelectedAttemptId instead; this callback is the command channel (record the winner, start the next step).

parameters.name: SelectedAttemptId
parameters.description: The confirmed winner, two-way bound with SelectedAttemptIdChanged (@bind-SelectedAttemptId). Its radio is checked and its column carries the "Chosen" mark. A host that BINDS it delegates the decision: the reader's confirmation reports the change and the next render from the host decides. A host that only PINS it (a value without SelectedAttemptIdChanged) keeps control: the confirmed pick is shown until the host renders again, and then the pinned value is restored. A host that sets neither keeps the reader's pick.

parameters.name: SelectedAttemptIdChanged
parameters.description: Fires with the newly confirmed winner (never a merely picked one).

parameters.name: ShowComparison
parameters.description: Whether the comparison table is rendered. Default true — it is the text alternative of the columns (the same numbers as a table), so a host hides it only when it renders its own.

parameters.name: ShowTitle
parameters.description: Whether the heading is rendered. Default true.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The heading above the surface. Null renders the localized default ("Parallel attempts").

notes: Picking a winner is a two-step action: the native radios choose and a confirmation raises OnSelect, so a stray arrow key cannot replace a recorded result.
The best attempt is the host's BestAttemptId when it names one, otherwise the highest score (ParallelAttemptRanking.Best).
The columns are a horizontal scroll-snap track: under 40rem of the component's own container they become a carousel with no JavaScript.
One polite live region announces the pending choice, the confirmed winner and a cancelled pick; the focus returns to the radio that opened the question.
